declarations.type:
∀ (expectedRound currentRound expectedLeaseEpoch currentLeaseEpoch expectedRevision currentRevision : Nat),
  expectedRound ≠ currentRound →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.RetryRoundFence expectedRound
        currentRound expectedLeaseEpoch currentLeaseEpoch expectedRevision currentRevision
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.stale_round_blocks_retry_fence

declarations.type:
∀ (delay : Nat → Nat) (maximumDelay attempts : Nat),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.BoundedBackoff delay maximumDelay →
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.TotalBackoff delay attempts ≤
      attempts * maximumDelay
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.total_backoff_is_bounded

declarations.type:
∀ {Candidate : Type} (candidate : Candidate) (maximumRounds : Nat)
  (scheduled eligible selected committed : Candidate → Nat → Prop),
  (∃ round, round < maximumRounds ∧ scheduled candidate round ∧ eligible candidate round ∧ selected candidate round) →
    (∀ (round : Nat),
        scheduled candidate round → eligible candidate round → selected candidate round → committed candidate round) →
      ∃ round, round < maximumRounds ∧ committed candidate round
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.conditional_bounded_recovery_liveness

declarations.type:
∀ {TransitionId CandidateId SnapshotId PolicyId : Type}
  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.RetryCommandKey TransitionId CandidateId
      SnapshotId PolicyId),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.RetryCommandCompatible left right →
    left.roundNumber = right.roundNumber
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.retry_command_compatibility_binds_round

declarations.type:

  (left right :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinBoundedRecoveryRetryFairness.RetryCommandKey TransitionId CandidateId
      SnapshotId PolicyId),
  left.roundNumber ≠ right.roundNumber →
